items.q: she would be with his wife Nuffy all the time, we called her Nuffy, you know. Great people.

ctx.x: So I talked to him and reminisced all the time, and we'd get upstairs late at night, up in that top bar up there, and we'd sit up there and eat hors d'oeuvres and stuff all night, you know, and sit there and reminisce about the big band, and she would be with his wife Nuffy all the time, we called her Nuffy, you know. Great people.
